events.title: Tupac Shakur Remembered
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled impact of Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55. His music still resonates, a powerful voice from the 90s that continues to influence.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of rock icon Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day. He would have been 84. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever and continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Flashback
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde B'day
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still delivering those timeless Pretenders hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the iconic Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today.

angles.name: Liam G B'day
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Fact
angles.copy: It's 51 years since John Lennon released the 'Imagine' album. A timeless masterpiece that still speaks volumes.

events.title: iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put a thousand songs in your pocket. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From 'Dr. No' in '62 to today, 007 has been defining cool for generations. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: John Cleese B'day
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Flashback
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. So many iconic tracks, so much debate. What's your top pick from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Remembered
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. He would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Flashback
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their incredible evolution. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this sombre day, we remember John Lennon, who was taken from us too soon. He would have been 86. His music and message of peace live on.
